paper_title: Nuclear decay anomalies as a signature of axion dark matter
notes: Headline result: axion DM search via periodic variation in 3H (tritium) beta-decay rate from 12 yr of JRC data. Abstract/conclusions/Fig.3 exclude axion decay constants f_a below 9.4e12 - 1.8e10 GeV (95% CL) for masses 1.7e-23 - 8.7e-21 eV. Reported in the AxionMass plane 1/f_a [GeV^-1] (the 'Tritium decay' region of Fig.3). Boundary of the excluded region is the two quoted endpoints, (m_a, f_a) = (1.7e-23 eV, 9.4e12 GeV) and (8.7e-21 eV, 1.8e10 GeV), converted to 1/f_a = (1.064e-13, 5.556e-11) GeV^-1. The product f_a*m_a is nearly constant (1.6e-10 GeV.eV), i.e. slope ~1 in log-log (consistent with Eq.13 effect ~ (1/(m_a f_a))^2); intermediate points are log-linear interpolation. Excluded region lies ABOVE this line (larger 1/f_a). Limit depends on local DM density via rho_DM/(0.45 GeV/cm^3) in Eqs.12-13, so dm_density_assumed=0.45; not rescaled. 'Tritium decay future' curves in Fig.3 are projections and excluded from the reported curve.
